creators.name: Georgy Savva
creators.role: Researcher at New York University; first author of Solaris
creators.bio: First author of Solaris (2026), a multiplayer video world model for Minecraft built with an automated multi-agent data-collection system at New York University.
creators.why: Works on world models that several players share, rather than a single observer.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学研究者，Solaris 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Solaris（2026）的第一作者。Solaris 是纽约大学推出的《我的世界》多人视频世界模型，配套一套自动化的多智能体数据采集系统。
creators.why_zh: 研究多名玩家共享的世界模型，而不只是单一观察者。

creators.name: Li Hu
creators.role: Researcher at Alibaba Tongyi Lab; first author of WanToFight
creators.bio: First author of WanToFight (2026), a real-time two-player fighting-game engine generated by a video model at Alibaba's Tongyi Lab.
creators.why: Brings adversarial, contact-heavy two-player interaction into generative game engines.
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室研究者，WanToFight 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WanToFight（2026）的第一作者。WanToFight 是阿里巴巴通义实验室用视频模型生成的实时双人格斗游戏引擎。
creators.why_zh: 把充满肢体接触的双人对抗交互引入生成式游戏引擎。

creators.name: Ziyang Ye
creators.role: Researcher at CUHK-Shenzhen; first author of WorldCast
creators.bio: First author of WorldCast (2026), a distributed multiplayer world model for Counter-Strike 2, with co-authors from CUHK-Shenzhen, SLAI, Tsinghua SIGS, Didi's Voyager Research and USTC.
creators.why: Shows how a shared generated world could scale the way a networked game does.
creators.role_zh: 香港中文大学（深圳）研究者，WorldCast 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WorldCast（2026）的第一作者。WorldCast 是面向《反恐精英 2》的分布式多人世界模型，合作者来自香港中文大学（深圳）、SLAI、清华大学深圳国际研究生院、滴滴 Voyager Research 与中国科学技术大学。
creators.why_zh: 展示了共享的生成世界如何像联网游戏一样扩展。

creators.name: Junchao Huang
creators.role: Researcher at CUHK-Shenzhen; first author of SolarWM
creators.bio: First author of SolarWM (2026), a fully open data and training stack for long-horizon video world models, and co-author of WorldCast.
creators.why: Makes world-model training reproducible with open data, code and weights.
creators.role_zh: 香港中文大学（深圳）研究者，SolarWM 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: SolarWM（2026）的第一作者，该工作为长时视频世界模型提供完全开放的数据与训练技术栈；他也是 WorldCast 的合作者。
creators.why_zh: 用开放的数据、代码与权重，让世界模型训练可以复现。

creators.name: RhOS.ai
creators.role: AI company; co-developer of the Khora multi-agent world model
creators.bio: Developed Khora with Ophilus.AI, a multi-agent world model released as a technical report with an online demo in August 2026.
creators.why: Works on a shared world state that many simultaneous players can query.
creators.role_zh: AI 公司，多智能体世界模型 Khora 的联合开发方
creators.bio_zh: 与 Ophilus.AI 联合开发多智能体世界模型 Khora，于 2026 年 8 月发布技术报告与在线演示。
creators.why_zh: 研究可供许多玩家同时查询的共享世界状态。

creators.name: Ophilus.AI
creators.role: AI company; co-developer of the Khora multi-agent world model
creators.bio: Co-developed Khora with RhOS.ai, a world model that renders any number of players' views from one shared world state (technical report, August 2026).
creators.why: Works on multi-agent world models in which participants can be added at run time.
creators.role_zh: AI 公司，多智能体世界模型 Khora 的联合开发方
creators.bio_zh: 与 RhOS.ai 联合开发 Khora：一个从同一份共享世界状态渲染任意数量玩家画面的世界模型（2026 年 8 月发布技术报告）。
creators.why_zh: 研究可在运行时增加参与者的多智能体世界模型。

creators.name: Zhifei Chen
creators.role: Researcher at HKUST (Guangzhou); first author of ReWorld
creators.bio: First author of ReWorld (2026), a real-time interactive world model with long-horizon memory developed at HKUST (Guangzhou) with Alibaba's ATH group.
creators.why: Works on world models that remember places over long sessions while still responding in real time.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）研究者，ReWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: ReWorld（2026）的第一作者。ReWorld 是香港科技大学（广州）与阿里巴巴 ATH 事业群合作开发的实时交互世界模型，具备长时记忆。
creators.why_zh: 研究在长时会话中记住地点、同时保持实时响应的世界模型。

creators.name: MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models
creators.role: Foundation-model institute of Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
creators.bio: Research institute at MBZUAI; in September 2026 its world-model group released LOCI (spatial linear memory) and Memorizon (training beyond the context window).
creators.why: Works on keeping streaming world models consistent when the camera revisits a place.
creators.role_zh: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学（MBZUAI）的基础模型研究院
creators.bio_zh: MBZUAI 下属研究院；2026 年 9 月，其世界模型团队发布了 LOCI（空间线性记忆）与 Memorizon（超出上下文窗口的训练）。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何让流式世界模型在相机重访同一地点时保持一致。

creators.name: Ji Xia
creators.role: Researcher at the MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models; first author of LOCI
creators.bio: First author of LOCI (2026), a streaming world model with a hybrid spatial memory, from the MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models group that also published Memorizon.
creators.why: Works on memory architectures that keep revisited places faithful at constant cost.
creators.role_zh: MBZUAI 基础模型研究院研究者，LOCI 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: LOCI（2026）的第一作者。LOCI 是采用混合空间记忆的流式世界模型，出自 MBZUAI 基础模型研究院的同一团队，该团队还发表了 Memorizon。
creators.why_zh: 研究以恒定开销让重访地点保持忠实的记忆结构。

creators.name: Hanlin Wang
creators.role: Researcher at HKUST; first author of WorldDirector
creators.bio: First author of WorldDirector (2026), a controllable video world model with persistent memory of moving objects, from HKUST and Ant Group.
creators.why: Works on keeping moving people and objects consistent in generated worlds.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学研究者，WorldDirector 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WorldDirector（2026）的第一作者。WorldDirector 是香港科技大学与蚂蚁集团合作的可控视频世界模型，能持久记住运动物体。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何让生成世界中运动的人和物保持一致。

creators.name: Seedleap.ai
creators.role: AI company behind the Zing world model and its Loopit web app
creators.bio: Released Zing-0.5, an open-weight real-time world model with joint keyboard and text control, in September 2026, with an SGLang serving stack and a web app at zing.loopit.me.
creators.why: Pushes playable real-time world models toward low serving cost.
creators.role_zh: 推出 Zing 世界模型及其 Loopit 网页应用的 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年 9 月发布开源权重的实时世界模型 Zing-0.5，支持键盘与文字联合控制，并提供基于 SGLang 的服务部署方案以及网页应用 zing.loopit.me。
creators.why_zh: 推动可玩的实时世界模型降低服务成本。

creators.name: Yang Zhou
creators.role: Researcher in Youku's Orange 3DV team; first author of MoVerse
creators.bio: First author of MoVerse (2026), a real-time world model that builds a panoramic 3D Gaussian scaffold from one image, from the Orange 3DV team of Youku's Moku Lab (Alibaba's Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group).
creators.why: Combines explicit 3D structure with video generation for worlds that keep their geometry.
creators.role_zh: 优酷 Orange 3DV 团队研究者，MoVerse 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: MoVerse（2026）的第一作者。MoVerse 是一个从单张图像构建全景三维高斯骨架的实时世界模型，出自优酷 Moku Lab 的 Orange 3DV 团队（阿里巴巴虎鲸文娱集团）。
creators.why_zh: 把显式三维结构与视频生成结合，让世界保持几何不变。

creators.name: Linxi Xie
creators.role: Researcher at Stanford University; first author of Generated Reality
creators.bio: First author of Generated Reality (CVPR 2026 Findings), a VR video world model controlled by tracked head and hand poses, from Gordon Wetzstein's group at Stanford with co-authors from NYU Shanghai and UNC.
creators.why: Connects world models to the body tracking that headsets already provide.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者，Generated Reality 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Generated Reality（CVPR 2026 Findings）的第一作者。该工作是由头部与手部追踪控制的 VR 视频世界模型，出自斯坦福大学 Gordon Wetzstein 团队，合作者来自上海纽约大学与北卡罗来纳大学。
creators.why_zh: 把世界模型与头显已有的身体追踪连接起来。

works.title: Solaris
works.description: A video world model that generates first-person views for two Minecraft players acting in the same world at once, keeping what each sees consistent with the other's actions; NYU released the weights, evaluation datasets and the multiplayer data-collection engine.
works.description_zh: 一个视频世界模型：同时为在同一个《我的世界》世界里行动的两名玩家分别生成第一人称画面，并让每人看到的内容与对方的动作保持一致；纽约大学公开了模型权重、评测数据集与多人数据采集引擎。
works.idea_en: Turns a world model from one observer into a shared space: when one player builds or walks away, the other player's view has to show it.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型从单一观察者变成共享空间：一名玩家建造或走开时，另一名玩家的画面也必须体现出来。
works.method: A staged pipeline moves from single-player to multiplayer modeling, combining bidirectional, causal and Self Forcing training, plus a memory-efficient Checkpointed Self Forcing variant for a longer-horizon teacher; trained on 12.6 million synchronized multiplayer frames collected by automated Minecraft bots.
works.method_zh: 分阶段训练，从单人建模过渡到多人建模，结合双向、因果与 Self Forcing 训练，并提出节省显存的 Checkpointed Self Forcing，以便使用更长时程的教师模型；训练数据是由自动化《我的世界》机器人采集的 1260 万帧同步多人画面。
works.specs: 2 players · Minecraft · 12.6M multiplayer training frames · JAX (TPU training, GPU inference)

paper.title: Solaris: Building a Multiplayer Video World Model in Minecraft

works.title: WanToFight
works.description: A generative game engine that renders two-player The King of Fighters '97 matches frame by frame from both players' keyboards, with the fight's contacts and outcomes produced by the network rather than by game code; Alibaba's Tongyi Lab reports 30 fps for a full match on one RTX 5090.
works.description_zh: 一个生成式游戏引擎：根据两名玩家各自的键盘输入，逐帧渲染双人对战的《拳皇 97》比赛，招式接触与胜负结果都由神经网络而非游戏代码生成；阿里巴巴通义实验室称其可在单张 RTX 5090 上以 30 fps 跑完整场比赛。
works.idea_en: Two people acting against each other in one generated scene at game speed: the adversarial, contact-heavy case that single-player world models avoid.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一个生成场景里以游戏速度相互对抗：这正是单人世界模型回避的、充满肢体接触的对抗情形。
works.method: Built on the Wan-1.3B video diffusion transformer: a streaming autoregressive generator with block-causal attention and a rolling KV cache, a visually grounded Player Association module that binds each keyboard stream to one character, and gated, locally causal keyboard injection trained with a single-player-to-full-match curriculum; a four-step DMD-distilled student with a pruned VAE decoder runs in real time.
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan-1.3B 视频扩散 Transformer：采用块因果注意力与滚动 KV 缓存的流式自回归生成器；以画面为依据、把每路键盘信号绑定到对应角色的“玩家关联”模块；以及按“从单人到完整对局”课程训练的门控、局部因果键盘注入模块；经四步 DMD 蒸馏的学生模型配合剪枝后的 VAE 解码器实时运行。

paper.title: WanToFight: Real-Time Generative Game Engine for Multi-Player Combat Interaction

works.title: WorldCast
works.description: A distributed multiplayer world model for Counter-Strike 2: each player's client generates its own view and exchanges only compact player and scene states with the others, so adding a player adds a client instead of enlarging one joint model; the authors report 16+ fps per client for 2 to 16 players, one GPU each.
works.description_zh: 一个面向《反恐精英 2》的分布式多人世界模型：每名玩家的客户端各自生成自己的画面，彼此只交换精简的玩家状态与场景状态，因此增加一名玩家只需多一个客户端，而不必扩大一个联合模型；作者称在 2 到 16 名玩家、每人一张 GPU 的条件下，每个客户端可达 16 fps 以上。
works.idea_en: Shared generated worlds could scale like networked games, with each participant rendering locally and only state travelling between them.
works.idea_zh: 共享的生成世界可以像联网游戏一样扩展：每位参与者在本地渲染，彼此之间只传递状态。
works.method: Each client pairs a video generator with a state model that estimates the player's position from generated video and controls; clients exchange player states, project them into camera-aligned player-state fields that guide where and how other players are drawn, and reuse each other's observations as shared scene state.
works.method_zh: 每个客户端由一个视频生成器和一个状态模型组成，状态模型根据生成画面与操作输入估计玩家位置；客户端之间交换玩家状态，并把它们投影为与相机对齐的“玩家状态场”，指导其他玩家在何处、以何种样子被画出，同时把彼此的观测复用为共享场景状态。
works.specs: 2–16 players · 16+ fps per client · 1 GPU per client · ~3.5 Mb/s received per client (developer-reported)

works.title: Khora
works.description: A multi-agent world model that keeps one shared world state and renders each player's view by querying it, so more observers can join at inference time without retraining; RhOS.ai and Ophilus.AI show it on Counter-Strike-style maps with an online demo and report roughly linear cost as views are added.
works.description_zh: 一个多智能体世界模型：维护一份共享的世界状态，每名玩家的画面都通过查询这份状态渲染出来，因此推理时可以加入更多观察者而无需重新训练；RhOS.ai 与 Ophilus.AI 在《反恐精英》类地图上展示了它，提供在线演示，并称成本随视角数量大致线性增长。
works.idea_en: Separates what is true in the world from what each person sees, the split a shared social situation needs once it holds more than a handful of people.
works.idea_zh: 把“世界里发生了什么”与“每个人看到了什么”分开；一旦共享的社会情境里不止寥寥几人，就需要这种拆分。
works.method: World-state evolution is decoupled from visual rendering, and a population-agnostic rendering mechanism brings in other agents' information, so cross-view consistency comes from the shared state rather than from dense attention between observation streams inside the video generator.
works.method_zh: 把世界状态的演化与画面渲染解耦，并以与人数无关的渲染机制引入其他智能体的信息，使跨视角一致性来自共享状态，而不是依赖视频生成器内部各观测流之间的稠密注意力。
works.specs: any number of agents at inference · ~linear scaling with views (developer-reported)

works.title: ReWorld
works.description: An interactive world model driven by keyboard and mouse that streams 704×1280 video in real time and keeps places consistent when the player leaves and returns, using a bounded memory of pose-indexed landmarks; from HKUST (Guangzhou) with Alibaba's ATH group, with 5B checkpoints released in September 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个由键盘和鼠标驱动的交互世界模型：实时流式输出 704×1280 视频，玩家离开后再回来时场景依然一致，靠的是一个按相机位姿索引“地标”、容量有上限的记忆；由香港科技大学（广州）与阿里巴巴 ATH 事业群合作，2026 年 9 月公开了 5B 模型权重。
works.idea_en: Real-time control and long memory can share one model if memory is budgeted: the world remembers a place without the cost growing as you roam.
works.idea_zh: 只要给记忆设定预算，实时控制与长时记忆就能共存于一个模型：世界记得去过的地方，而开销不会随着漫游距离增长。
works.method: Mixed per-head attention windows (most heads local, a few global over the whole history) with random head routing and chunk dropping in training; at inference a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank; a metric-scale data engine puts eight sources on one action scale, and DMD distillation in a LoRA adapter gives a four-step real-time mode.
works.method_zh: 训练时为注意力头设置不同窗口（多数头只看近处，少数全局头看完整历史），并随机路由注意力头、随机丢弃片段；推理时使用有上限的 KV 缓存，配合按位姿索引的地标库；按真实尺度对齐的数据引擎把八类数据源统一到同一动作尺度；在 LoRA 适配器中做 DMD 蒸馏，得到四步实时模式。

paper.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

works.title: SolarWM
works.description: A fully open stack for building long-horizon interactive world models: 1.43 million camera-annotated clips (25 TB) from ten datasets, one training recipe, and four released models of 5B to 33B parameters built on Wan2.2, LTX-2.5 and MiniMax-H3; the authors report minute- to hour-scale real-time rollouts from models trained on five-second clips.
works.description_zh: 一套完全开放、用于构建长时交互世界模型的技术栈：来自十个数据集、带相机标注的 143 万段视频（25 TB），一套统一的训练方法，以及基于 Wan2.2、LTX-2.5 与 MiniMax-H3 的四个 5B 至 33B 参数模型；作者称这些只用五秒片段训练的模型可以实时推演数分钟乃至数小时。
works.idea_en: An open, documented data and training pipeline makes world models something a lab can rebuild and compare, not only download.
works.idea_zh: 开放且有完整文档的数据与训练流程，让世界模型成为实验室可以复现、可以比较的东西，而不只是下载来用。
works.method: A reconfigurable multi-source data engine converts clips into one frame-aligned format (observations, metric camera geometry, captions, quality and provenance metadata); a backbone-native adaptation framework applies a three-stage recipe (bidirectional adaptation, teacher-forced autoregressive initialization, distribution matching distillation) to each video backbone.
works.method_zh: 可重新配置的多源数据引擎把视频片段转换为统一的逐帧对齐格式（画面、真实尺度的相机几何、文字描述、质量与来源元数据）；“保留骨干原生结构”的适配框架对每个视频骨干模型执行三阶段训练：双向适配、教师强制的自回归初始化，以及分布匹配蒸馏。

paper.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models

works.title: LOCI
works.description: A streaming, camera-controlled world model with a hybrid spatial memory: half of its transformer blocks keep a cache of past frames, the other half a compact recurrent memory addressed by camera geometry, so a place looks the same when the camera returns; the authors stream it on one H200 and report about 30% lower peak memory than full attention.
works.description_zh: 一个流式、可控相机的世界模型，采用混合空间记忆：一半 Transformer 模块保留历史帧缓存，另一半使用按相机几何寻址的紧凑循环记忆，因此相机回到原处时画面依旧；作者在单张 H200 上流式运行，并称峰值显存比全注意力低约 30%。
works.idea_en: Combines exact recall of what was seen with a fixed-size summary, so revisits stay faithful without memory growing with session length.
works.idea_zh: 把对已见画面的精确回忆与固定大小的摘要结合起来，使重访保持忠实，而记忆不会随会话时长膨胀。
works.method: Alternating blocks: cache-backed main attention, and chunk-local attention complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry; recurrent readouts feed the queries of later cache-backed blocks; a four-step distilled student streams the video.
works.method_zh: 交替使用两类模块：一类是带缓存的主注意力；另一类只关注当前片段，并辅以循环线性注意力记忆，其读写都以相机投影几何为条件；循环记忆的读出作为后续带缓存模块的查询输入；由四步蒸馏的学生模型流式生成视频。
works.specs: 864×480 · 4 denoising steps per chunk · 1 H200 · ~30% lower peak memory than full softmax (developer-reported)

paper.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models

works.title: WorldDirector
works.description: A controllable world-simulator framework in which a language model first plans the 3D paths of moving characters and the camera, and a video model then renders them, so a person or animal that leaves the frame returns in the right place with the same appearance; from HKUST and Ant Group, with 14B weights released.
works.description_zh: 一个可控的世界模拟框架：先由语言模型规划运动角色与相机的三维轨迹，再由视频模型渲染出来，因此离开画面的人或动物再次出现时，位置正确、外观不变；由香港科技大学与蚂蚁集团合作，已公开 14B 模型权重。
works.idea_en: Keeping the plan of who moves where outside the pixels lets a generated world remember moving things, not just static scenery.
works.idea_zh: 把“谁往哪里走”的计划放在像素之外，生成的世界就能记住会动的东西，而不只是静态布景。
works.method: Decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation: an LLM coordinates 3D object trajectories with camera movement, and the orchestrated trajectories condition a 14B video generator at 480p.
works.method_zh: 把语义层面的运动编排与画面生成解耦：由大语言模型协调物体三维轨迹与相机运动，再以编排好的轨迹作为条件，驱动 14B 视频生成模型输出 480p 视频。

paper.title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory

works.title: WorldCrafter
works.description: A video world model from Tencent ARC Lab whose memory is queried by the camera: past views are compressed into a fixed set of tokens shaped by the viewpoint being requested, which keeps revisited places and orbits consistent; base and distilled fast weights and a Hugging Face demo are public.
works.description_zh: 腾讯 ARC 实验室的视频世界模型，其记忆由相机来“查询”：历史画面按照即将请求的视角被压缩成固定数量的 token，从而让重访的地点和环绕镜头保持一致；基础版与蒸馏加速版权重以及 Hugging Face 在线演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Letting the next viewpoint decide what to keep from the past is a cheap way to hold a world together within a fixed token budget.
works.idea_zh: 让下一个视角决定从过去保留什么，是在固定 token 预算内维持世界一致性的低成本办法。
works.method: A memory encoder and a pose-conditioned readout module, trained jointly with the video generator, integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target-view-specific tokens (an implicit 3D-aware memory).
works.method_zh: 与视频生成器联合训练的记忆编码器和以位姿为条件的读出模块，把历史观测整合为一组固定数量、针对目标视角的 token（隐式的三维感知记忆）。

paper.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory

works.title: SANA-WM
works.description: NVIDIA's open 2.6B-parameter world model, trained natively for one-minute 720p videos that follow a given 6-DoF camera path; NVIDIA reports quality comparable to LingBot-World and HY-WorldPlay at far lower cost, with 15 days of training on 64 H100s and one GPU per one-minute clip.
works.description_zh: 英伟达开源的 26 亿参数世界模型，原生训练即面向一分钟、720p、沿给定六自由度相机路径运动的视频；英伟达称其画质可与 LingBot-World、HY-WorldPlay 相当而成本低得多：在 64 张 H100 上训练 15 天，每段一分钟视频只需一张 GPU。
works.idea_en: Minute-long camera-controlled worlds from a model small enough for one consumer GPU bring world generation within reach of a single lab machine.
works.idea_zh: 小到能在一张消费级显卡上运行的模型就能生成一分钟可控相机的世界，让单台实验室机器也能做世界生成。
works.method: Hybrid linear attention (frame-wise Gated DeltaNet plus softmax attention) for long context, dual-branch camera control, a two-stage pipeline with a long-video refiner, and metric-scale 6-DoF camera poses extracted from about 213K public clips.
works.method_zh: 用混合线性注意力（逐帧 Gated DeltaNet 加 softmax 注意力）处理长上下文，采用双分支相机控制、带长视频精修器的两阶段生成流程，并从约 21.3 万段公开视频中提取真实尺度的六自由度相机位姿作为监督。
works.specs: 2.6B · 720p · 60 s clips · distilled NVFP4 variant denoises a 60 s clip in 34 s on one RTX 5090 (developer-reported)

paper.title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer

works.title: minWM
works.description: An open-source, end-to-end framework and tutorial from Shengshu (the Vidu company) that turns an existing text- or image-to-video model into a camera-controllable, few-step autoregressive world model for low-latency streaming, demonstrated on Wan2.1-1.3B and HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B.
works.description_zh: 生数科技（Vidu 背后的公司）开源的端到端框架与教程：把现有的文生视频或图生视频模型改造成可控相机、少步自回归、低延迟流式输出的世界模型，并在 Wan2.1-1.3B 与 HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B 上做了演示。
works.idea_en: Makes the recipe for a real-time world model a reproducible pipeline that a lab can run on open backbones.
works.idea_zh: 把实时世界模型的配方变成实验室能在开源骨干模型上复现的流程。
works.method: Fine-tunes a bidirectional video diffusion model with camera control, then applies the Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++ pipeline (autoregressive diffusion training, causal ODE or consistency distillation, asymmetric DMD) for few-step rollout; it can also adapt existing world models such as HY-WorldPlay.
works.method_zh: 先为双向视频扩散模型加入相机控制微调，再套用 Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++ 流程（自回归扩散训练、因果 ODE 或一致性蒸馏、非对称 DMD），得到少步自回归生成器；也可用于改造 HY-WorldPlay 等现有世界模型。

paper.title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models

works.title: EchoWM
works.description: JD's open omnimodal world model, part of JoyAI-Echo 1.5: as a user moves through a scene in first or third person, it generates 720p video together with environmental sound, music and speech that stay synchronized over long sessions.
works.description_zh: 京东开源的全模态世界模型，属于 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 的一部分：用户以第一或第三人称在场景中移动时，它同时生成 720p 视频以及环境音、音乐与语音，并在长时会话中保持同步。
works.idea_en: Sound is generated with the picture inside the world model, so an entered scene can sound right from the start instead of having audio added afterwards.
works.idea_zh: 声音与画面在世界模型内部一起生成，进入的场景从一开始就有合适的声音，而不是事后再配音。
works.method: Discrete commands and continuous poses map to one metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory; third-person camera-character dynamics are learned from data; a dedicated data engine, progressive joint audio-visual training and autoregressive post-training extend generation to long horizons.
works.method_zh: 把离散指令与连续位姿统一映射为真实尺度的相对六自由度轨迹；第三人称下相机与角色的运动关系直接从数据中学习；借助专门的数据引擎、渐进式音视频联合训练与自回归后训练，把生成延伸到长时程。

paper.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models

works.title: Zing-0.5
works.description: An open-weight 5B world model from Seedleap.ai in which a player walks through a generated world with the keyboard and types text to change what happens next, without restarting generation; the developers report 832×480 at 24 fps for about US$0.009 of server rental per stream-minute.
works.description_zh: 涌跃智能（Seedleap.ai）推出的开源权重 5B 世界模型：玩家用键盘在生成的世界中行走，同时可以输入文字改变接下来发生的事，且无需重新开始生成；开发者称其以 832×480、24 fps 运行，每分钟流式画面的服务器租用成本约 0.009 美元。
works.idea_en: Keyboard and text control together let someone steer events mid-scene, and the reported cost makes long sessions cheap.
works.idea_zh: 键盘与文字同时控制，让人能在场景进行中改变事件走向；开发者报告的成本让长时间体验变得便宜。
works.method: Unified conditioning on magnitude-aware keyboard inputs and temporally aligned text instructions; a segment-level teacher trained on multi-prompt videos supervises a block-causal student through DMD; four-step generation with context-preserving streaming, served by an SGLang-based WebSocket server.
works.method_zh: 把带力度信息的键盘输入与时间对齐的文字指令统一作为条件；在多提示词连续视频上训练的片段级教师模型，通过 DMD 监督块因果学生模型；四步生成配合保留上下文的流式推理，并以基于 SGLang 的 WebSocket 服务部署。

paper.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control

works.title: MoVerse
works.description: A real-time world model that turns one ordinary photo into a scene you can roam: it completes a 360° panorama, lifts it into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold, then renders photoreal video along the user's camera path; from Youku's Orange 3DV team (Alibaba), at a reported 8 fps.
works.description_zh: 一个实时世界模型，把一张普通照片变成可以漫游的场景：先补全为 360° 全景，再提升为持久的三维高斯“骨架”，最后沿用户的相机路径渲染出照片级视频；由优酷（阿里巴巴）Orange 3DV 团队推出，作者报告帧率为 8 fps。
works.idea_en: An explicit 3D scaffold under a video renderer keeps geometry fixed when you look away, while the picture stays photoreal.
works.idea_zh: 在视频渲染器下面垫一层显式三维骨架，转头再回来时几何保持不变，画面依然逼真。
works.method: Topology-aware diffusion expands the input into a gravity-aligned 360° panorama; panoramic geometry-aware residual prediction lifts it to a 3D Gaussian scaffold; a Gaussian-conditioned video renderer, a bidirectional teacher distilled into a causal student, turns scaffold renders into video.
works.method_zh: 用拓扑感知的扩散模型把输入扩展为重力对齐的 360° 全景；通过全景几何感知的残差预测，把全景提升为三维高斯骨架；再由以高斯渲染为条件的视频渲染器（双向教师模型蒸馏为因果学生模型）把骨架渲染结果转成视频。
works.specs: 1 image in · 360° panorama → 3D Gaussian scaffold · 8 fps (developer-reported)

paper.title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold

works.title: Generated Reality
works.description: A video world model for VR driven by the wearer's tracked head pose and joint-level hand poses: reaching and grabbing in the headset changes the generated egocentric scene, which is streamed back at about 11 fps. In the Stanford team's user studies, participants completed tasks more often and reported significantly more control than with baselines.
works.description_zh: 一个面向 VR 的视频世界模型，由佩戴者被追踪的头部位姿和关节级手部姿态驱动：在头显中伸手抓取，生成的第一人称场景随之变化，并以约 11 fps 流式传回头显。斯坦福团队的用户研究中，参与者的任务成功率更高，主观控制感也明显强于基线。
works.idea_en: Puts the body, not a keyboard, in control of a generated world, which is what headset-based situations need; the frame rate is still far below comfortable VR.
works.idea_zh: 让身体而不是键盘来控制生成的世界，这正是基于头显的情境所需要的；不过帧率仍远低于舒适 VR 的要求。
works.method: Compares diffusion-transformer conditioning strategies and proposes one for 3D head and hand control (UmeTrack hand representation from a commercial VR headset); a bidirectional video diffusion teacher is distilled into a causal autoregressive model that streams to the headset; a human-subject study compares task success and perceived control against baselines (sample size not stated on the project page).
works.method_zh: 比较多种扩散 Transformer 条件注入方式，提出适用于三维头部与手部控制的方案（手部采用商用 VR 头显提供的 UmeTrack 表示）；把双向视频扩散教师模型蒸馏为因果自回归模型，向头显流式输出；通过人类被试研究与基线比较任务成功率与主观控制感（项目主页未给出样本量）。
works.specs: ~11 fps on a VR headset · head + joint-level hand pose control (developer-reported)

leads.why: Technical report of MIRA (General Intuition with Kyutai): same 2026-07-06 date, Rocket League, 5B, four players, 20 fps. Already in the data as general-intuition--mira, whose paper field could take arXiv 2607.05352.

WorldCrafter (arXiv 2609.24984)
leads.why: Added in round 2 as wangbo-yu--worldcrafter (Tencent ARC Lab; 511 GitHub stars, official demo video).

leads.name: Khora: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling (rhos.ai, arXiv 2608.08600)
Oneira (arXiv 2610.01614) and ReWorld (arXiv 2608.23565)
leads.why: ReWorld added in round 2 as zhifei-chen--reworld; Oneira re-listed below as its own open lead.

leads.name: Decart Oasis 3 Preview (real-time action-to-frames world model)
leads.why: The same model is already in the data as decart--oasis-3 (world-models).

leads.name: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models (arXiv 2610.01614)
leads.why: Oct 2026; open-world interaction and object insertion in video world models; project page with comparison videos and example weights. Candidate for world-models/memory or general next round.

leads.name: MASS: Multiplayer World Models with Authoritative Shared State (Alaya Lab, arXiv 2608.06257)
leads.why: 2026-08-06: a learned Logic Engine advances an authoritative typed world state from joint actions and a Rendering Engine draws any player's view; 1,024 concurrent players for 10,000 steps on a multiplayer Snake benchmark. Project page has figures only, no video, as of 2026-10-18.

leads.name: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window (MBZUAI IFM, arXiv 2610.00544)
leads.why: Sibling of LOCI: supervises revisits over spans longer than the attention window through a shared retrieval bank. Project page has no video as of 2026-10-18.

leads.name: MetaWorld: Scaling Multi-Agent Video World Model from Single-view Video Data (arXiv 2606.02753)
leads.why: 2026-06-01: trains a multi-agent world model from single-view video by splitting ego-motion from the subject's trajectory. No project page or video in the arXiv record.

leads.name: Prisma-World: Camera-Controllable Multi-Agent Video World Model (arXiv 2606.09507)
leads.why: HUST, NTU S-Lab and SenseTime, 2026-06-08: joint geometry-aware denoising of all agents' views; project page with videos. Not added: multiplayer already covered by Solaris, WorldCast, Khora, Gamma-World and MIRA.

leads.name: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory (arXiv 2606.17730)
leads.why: 2026-06-16: object interaction mid-rollout (pick up plates, open doors) via action-aware memory and new interaction data; project page with comparison videos. Candidate for world-models/memory (reactivity).

leads.name: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression (KAIST, arXiv 2605.22718)
leads.why: Training-free KV-cache retrieval and compression for consistent revisits; project page with videos. Not added: overlaps ReWorld, LOCI and WorldCrafter.

leads.name: BiWM: Advancing Open-Source Interactive Video World Models with Bidirectional Autoregression (arXiv 2606.10135)
leads.why: 2026-06-08, Yume authors: open full-stack training framework for bidirectional autoregressive world models on Wan2.1/2.2, HunyuanVideo-1.5 and LTX-2.3. No project page in the arXiv record; check GitHub for code and video.

leads.name: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World (Alaya Lab, arXiv 2608.13546)
leads.why: Alaya-EVOKE-Turbo tops the public WBench leaderboard (overall 82.0) as of 2026-10-18, ahead of XGEN-Jing (81.9); check for a project page and video.

leads.name: ME-World: Multi-Agent Egocentric World Model with Fine-Grained Embodied Interaction (KAIST, arXiv 2610.12299)
leads.why: Oct 2026; multi-agent egocentric world model with hand-level interaction; project page with videos and code. Candidate for world-models/simulation.

leads.name: Generated Reality: Human-centric World Simulation using Interactive Video Generation with Hand and Camera Control (Xie et al., CVPR 2026 Findings)
leads.why: Added in round 2 as linxi-xie--generated-reality (world-models, also genxr).

leads.name: AlayaVista: Streaming World Modeling from Panoramic States to Perspective Video (arXiv 2609.14462)
leads.why: Alaya Lab, 2026-09-13: streaming world model that keeps a panoramic state and renders perspective video; project page with intro and rotating-camera mp4s (loaded from the JS bundle). Not added: overlaps MoVerse and PanoWorld; candidate for world-models/memory next round.
